description: This script converts Pascal VOC dataset annotations to YOLO format, processing XML annotation files, copying images, and generating label files for training object detection models.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from absolute to relative format based on image size.

methods.name: convert_annotation
methods.description: Parses an XML annotation file to extract object class labels and bounding boxes, converting them to YOLO format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes dataset directories, copies images, converts annotations, and writes label files.
